purpose: gnsslad15 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 155): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..12 then NEW step 13 (2 s console pause first): steps 1..13, 5 s powered with status reads, then full rollback. Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
